name: Lord Cobrahn
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Lord Cobrahn commands the corrupted Druids of the Fang. He was a night elf druid in Naralex's order, until the nightmare in the cavern springs claimed him. Now he guards the twisted labyrinth in a deadly serpent guise.

sections.title: A Druid Corrupted
sections.body: Lord Cobrahn once served Naralex in his druid order. When Naralex entered the Wailing Caverns beneath the Barrens, he hoped to draw upon the underground springs and restore life to the arid wastes. Cobrahn went with him. But Naralex's communion with the Emerald Dream decayed into a twisting nightmare, and Cobrahn's mind shattered with those of his brothers.

sections.title: The Serpent's Embrace
sections.body: The nightmare warped Cobrahn's shapeshifting into a predatory reptilian form unlike the totemic beasts of Cenarion tradition. In battle, he takes the guise of a deadly serpent. Venomous deviate pythons flank him, and a vicious claw marks his right hand. Cobrahn rules his part of the grottos and violently purges anyone who tries to break the nightmare's hold on the caverns.

faq.q: Who was Lord Cobrahn before he turned evil?
faq.answer: Before the nightmare claimed him, Cobrahn was a night elf druid in Naralex's order. He entered the Wailing Caverns with Naralex, hoping their springs could heal the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is he called Lord Cobrahn?
faq.answer: No account explains the name Lord Cobrahn. The title suits a druid twisted by the Wailing Caverns' nightmare into a lethal serpent form, with deviate pythons at his side. The other Fang leaders, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis, also bear serpentine names.

faq.q: Where can Lord Cobrahn be found?
faq.answer: Lord Cobrahn resides deep within the Wailing Caverns, a twisting underground network in the central Barrens. Deviate pythons and other beasts corrupted by the nightmare surround him.

faq.q: Why do adventurers need to defeat him?
faq.answer: Cobrahn leads the Druids of the Fang and carries the Gem of Cobrahn. Nara Wildmane of Thunder Bluff seeks the gem to break the Fang leaders' hold over the Barrens.

faq.q: What unique physical traits does he possess?
faq.answer: Cobrahn is larger than ordinary night elves and bears a sharp claw on his right hand. In combat, he can transform completely into an oversized venomous snake.

faq.q: What is his connection to the other Druids of the Fang?
faq.answer: Cobrahn is one of the four Fanglords, alongside Lady Anacondra and their kin. All were druids in Naralex's order, entered the caverns with him, and fell together to the nightmare's twisting corruption.

angles.text: For druids, Cobrahn shows how the nightmare can warp shapeshifting away from natural balance.
For night elves, Cobrahn's fall is a bitter tragedy. A skilled brother of the Cenarion Circle abandoned his heritage and now leads monsters in the subterranean depths.
As a Horde adventurer, you seek Cobrahn to end the foul corruption leaking into the Barrens and protect Kalimdor's fragile plains.
